summary: This Form 6-K reports a routine change in the company's independent registered public accounting firm. On June 29, 2026, UHY Malaysia PLT resigned as auditor, and on July 3, 2026, SFAI Malaysia PLT was appointed to audit the fiscal year ending December 31, 2025. The filing states no disagreements or reportable events occurred. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, tender, or other special-situation elements. The filing is a standard auditor change disclosure under Item 304 of Regulation S-K. No further action or event is anticipated beyond the auditor transition.
